title: FACTION MEMORY PASS WARDROBE
description: The feature rebuilds routine play around the moment a player considers leaving. NPCs now remember a handful of faction choices and respond with small grudges instead of universal politeness. Outfits now include prestige variants, matching effects, and a bundle preview that understands insecurity.
consequence: The world developed a memory just large enough to be inconvenient. Self-expression gained tiers, timers, and a receipt.

title: FACTION MEMORY PASS COOLDOWN
description: The release frames the feature as seasonal structure, while burying the real priority in the reward cadence. NPCs now remember a handful of faction choices and respond with small grudges instead of universal politeness. Limited-time labels and countdown nudges have been softened across the event shop.
consequence: The world developed a memory just large enough to be inconvenient. Players felt less hunted. The dashboard noticed immediately.

title: NARRATIVE COMPRESSION SPRINT WARDROBE
description: The change decides which delays are atmosphere and which delays are invoices. Side stories now resolve faster so players can return to reward tracks before the mood becomes measurable. Outfits now include prestige variants, matching effects, and a bundle preview that understands insecurity.
consequence: The kingdom's grief was preserved as a tooltip and two currencies. Self-expression gained tiers, timers, and a receipt.
